patch.value: Make ordinary changelog ordering total for undated items

Audience-contract review exposed a broader existing generator ordering gap outside the audience projection fix. compareItems compares two dated items by time, but falls back to title when either item is undated; this is not a transitive ordering. With closed Task A dated 2026-10-19, undated Feature B, and Task C dated 2026-10-20, reversing inputs changes type section order in buildChangelogDocument. The audience contract path now canonicalizes input, sections and item IDs without changing ordinary changelog presentation. Track the ordinary generator independently; related item pmc-audience-contracts and PR 271.

Use a total item order with an explicit undated policy and deterministic tie breakers; ordinary changelog projections are invariant across all six permutations of the three-item repro; preserve existing release selection and cover JSON and markdown behavior.
